terms.comment: A medieval word (Morgan–Owens points to a fourteenth-century source), taken up by the botanists: ribes rubrum the redcurrant, ribes nigrum the blackcurrant (Linnaeus). Morgan–Owens has it as a third-declension masculine after Mattioli (1571), or indeclinable. Its vowel lengths are not established.

sources: Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. berry: currant.
